summary.text: Julie Kelzer is the Democratic candidate for Minnesota State Senate District 17 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Glenn Gruenhagen (R).
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a self-employed residential home cleaner and the mother of a 20-year-old son and a 9-year-old daughter.

paragraphs.text: Kelzer said in a Ballotpedia survey that she has worked in customer service since age 14, including in salons, and that those jobs built her skills in communication and problem-solving.

In the same survey she named paid leave and universal school meal mandates, rent-payment reporting to credit bureaus, an income-based property tax for residents over 65, rural health care and farm estate taxes among her priorities.
She listed endorsements from Education Minnesota, Carver County Indivisible, Friends of the BWCA, Gender Justice and the DFL Rural Caucus.
